|lore=Corellian bounty hunter. Assassin trained by the Empire. Has reflex-enhancing cyber-implants. Gravely injured during a swoop race in the crystal swamp of Agrilat. Blames Han Solo.
|game_text=Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys free aboard Punishing One, and while piloting it, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Cancels Han's game text at same site. Immune to creature attacks and Fallen Portal.
|printings={{Card versions/Dengar (Dagobah)}}
|notes=The Players Committee released the original-layout slip for Dengar on 30 May 2003. The published Set 5 editions are linked as [[Dengar (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time)|Original]] and [[Dengar (V) (Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time) (Errata)|Remastered (2006)]]. The first sheet was released 30 May 2003 and became tournament legal on 6 June. The 2003 slips describe immunity to creature attacks. The remaster says Dengar may not be attacked. Both keep the same Fallen Portal immunity, same-site Han cancellation and free deployment and battle destiny on Punishing One.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20030801181811/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGVirtualSet5.pdf Virtual Set #5 first release sheet] (theforce.net, 30 May 2003; Internet Archive 1 August 2003), page 3, slip 34.
* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf Virtual Set #5 revised sheet] (publisher index dates the edition 19 June 2003), res.starwarsccg.org, page 3, slip 34. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114014729/https://swccg.com/snapshots/psa/reflections381-batch2-primary-sources.html Internet Archive primary-source copy].
* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf VirtualCards5.pdf] (Remaster sheet, official text as of 4 December 2006; Internet Archive 24 October 2007).
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Dengar]].

=== Publication sources ===
* '''Source publication''' (this page): first release sheet “Virtual Set #5” (Players Committee, 30 May 2003; tournament legal 6 June 2003), page 3, slip 34 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20030801181811/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGVirtualSet5.pdf PDF on theforce.net] linked from the [https://web.archive.org/web/20030603182926/http://swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm PC news post of 30 May 2003] (Internet Archive capture of the PDF, 1 August 2003; PDF dated 30–31 May 2003): “P 2. Deploys free aboard Punishing One, and while piloting it, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. Cancels Han's game text at same site. Immune to creature attacks and Fallen Portal.” Stats line: “POWER 2 ABILITY 2”. Deploy 3, forfeit 6. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “5•34” at bottom right and no expansion icon. The revised sheet of 11 June 2003 (PDF dated 11 June 2003; the copy the Players Committee still hosts at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf res.starwarsccg.org]) prints the same words on the same old slip ([[:File:OVS5-34-Dengar-original-slip-2003-06-11.png]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261114014729/https://swccg.com/snapshots/psa/reflections381-batch2-primary-sources.html Internet Archive primary-source copy].
* '''Source publication''' ([[Dengar (V) (Virtual Set 5) (Errata)]]): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007], slip 34), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Deploys free aboard ''Punishing One'', and while piloting it, draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. At same site, Han’s game text is canceled. May not be attacked. Immune to Fallen Portal.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
|hatnote=This is the original 30 May 2003 printing of [[Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time]] (old pre-Remaster slip). For the current text, see [[Dengar (V) (Virtual Set 5) (Errata)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Dengar]].
|effective=6 June 2003<ref name="date-ovs5-release-20030530" />
